name: Allcable
old_description: Allcable is your leading distributor for power, signal, lighting, video, voice, and data needs.
about:
Allcable, a wire and cable distributor, has operated from Denver, Colorado since its founding in 1983. The company maintains a second location in Oxnard, California, serving customers across the western United States. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company stocks and distributes a range of cable products including fiber optic, voice and data, access control, security, surveillance, lighting, and home theater wiring. Beyond distribution, Allcable provides custom cable services such as cutting, striping, dying, printing, twisting, paralleling, bundling, and respooling. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

Allcable serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and contract manufacturers, positioning itself as a stocking partner that can support product life cycles from design and prototype through full production. The company also supplies contractors and integrators in the security, lighting, and home theater markets, offering products like badge-entry systems, cameras, smoke detectors, door locks, and speaker wire.

Allcable emphasizes its role as a stocking distributor that helps customers reduce shipping and inventory costs. Its custom services are promoted as a way to get cable prepared to exact specifications, with the company stating it can dye almost any cable to a specific color and cut and strip to desired lengths.
